tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: dam chos sprul sku snying thig las: 'phags pa thugs rje chen po nam mkha' rgyal po'i phrin las rang gzhung 'gro don lhun grub nor bu pad+ma'i phreng ba bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: 'phags mchog thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo: de sgrub las byang rim pa 'di bzhin bya: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las: dang po sngon 'gro'i las rim brgyad bstan no: skyabs su 'gro dang sems bskyed dang: sgrub rdzas bsham dang bshags sbyang dang: bka' bsgo dang ni mtshams gcad dang: byin gyis dbab dang mchod byin brlab: sngon 'gro rnam pa rim dgu 'o: na mo gu ru dhe wa dhā kī nī: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: dang po skyabs sems bshags sbyang sngon song nas: gsum pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: bdag nyid skad cig gis dpal chen po pad+ma dbang chen sku mdog dmar nag shin tu khros pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas zhal dkar ba: g.yon zhal sngo ba: dbus zhal dmar nag tu 'bar ba: spyan gsum sdang mig bar snang gi khams su gzigs pa: sma ra smin ma me 'od 'phro ba: zhal gdangs shing ljags 'dril ba: gnam lcags kyi mche ba zang yag tu gtsigs pa: dbu skra dmar ser srid pa'i rtse mo na me ltar du 'bar ba: skra gseb na rta mgo ljang gu gsum gyis rta skad nam mkha'i dbyings su sgrog pas: snang srid thams cad dbang du sdud cing bgegs dpung thams cad zil gyis gnon pa: phyag drug g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags: g.yon gsum na dril bu bhan dmar lcags sgrog bsnams pa: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi 'dor thabs su bsgrad pa: sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad gnon pa: yum mchog tsa ti dbang phyug ma dang gnyis med du 'khril ba: dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang dpal gyi chas dgus brgyan pa ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du hrīḥhrīḥzhes pa'i sgra sgrog pas: 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bgegs dpung thams cad tshar gcod pa: hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa'i sgra sgrog pas: steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad ye shes kyi me dpung dang: 'ja' 'od dang yig 'bru dang mtshon cha la sogs pa rang snang las grub pa'i gzhal yas kyi khang chen po gcig tu

bsam: hrīḥhūm̐: nga ni dpal chen dbang gi lha: rta skad rngam sgrog bar chad sel: rang rig rang 'khrul sems can rnams: nyon mongs rnam rtog bag chags kyis: lha dang 'dre bgegs gnyis snang yang: rnam par rtog pa'i bgegs yin no: 'dre bgegs rang gi sems las byung: sems nyid ye nas chos sku la: bgegs dang bar chad ming yang med: gnyis med rang grol chos sku'i mtshams: 'di la sus kyang 'da' mi 'gyur: hrīḥhrīḥhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: byin 'beb ni: hūm̐ hrī: rgyal ba'i zhing mchog ri bo ta la dang: phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams dpag med nas: bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs: thugs rje chen po yab yum sras 'khor bcas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung rgya mtsho rnams: rang rang so so'i gnas nas sku skyod la: gzhal yas dkyil 'khor 'di la byin chen phob: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor rnams la dbang zhi skur: sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsgyur du gsol: snang gsal zhun mar 'di la mdangs phyungs shig: 'dir tshogs skal ldan rnams la dngos grub stsol: sarba ma hā gu ru ār+ya lo ke shwa ra gha gha rā dza dz+nyā na dhā ki sa pa ri wā ra a be sha ya ā ā: mchod pa byin rlabs ni: oṃ badz+ra a mṛta sogs: swa bhā wa sa sbyang: stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i: mchod yon: zhabs bsil: me tog: bdug spos: snang gsal: dri chab: zhal zas: rol mo la sogs pa: sa gzhi dang nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang bar gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐: de bzhin du/ badz+ra puṣ+pe= badz+ra dhū pe= badz+ra ā lo ke= badz+ra ghan+dhe= badz+ra nai bid+ya= badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: ma hā bho dhi tsit+ta gha ṇa ghu h+ya sarba pū tsa ho: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dz+wa ba liṃ ta bha la bha ti gu h+ya sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭha:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la ma dha la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: a: chos rnams kun gyi de bzhin nyid: stong nyid bsam brjod bral ba yi: thugs rjes kun tu snang ba yi: sems can yongs la khyab par bsgom: stong zhing snying rje'i ngang nyid las: rang byung rgyu yi sa bon hrī: a 'thas 'khrul pa'i zhen pa bzlog: sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin bskyed: gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: rang byung rgyu yi sa bon las: 'od zer rnam pa lnga 'phros pas: 'byung ba rnam dag brtsegs pa'i steng: rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang: rnam dag 'od lnga'i dkyil dbus su: sgrub gsum rig pas 'phrul/ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni: ma lus sems can sogs/ hūm̐ hrī: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po nam mkha'i rgyal: chos kyi dbyings nas 'gro ba'i don phyir du: gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pho brang gzhal yas 'dir: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs phyir gshegs su gsol: 'phags ma dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum: nor 'dzin gsang 'dzin sgrol ma dkar sngon dang: rgyal ba rigs lnga sems dpa' lcam dral rnams: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs phyir gshegs su gsol: 'gro drug don mdzad sprul sku thub pa drug: gang la gang 'dul thabs sprul sna tshogs kyis: sangs rgyas stong rtsa rgyal ba 'khor bcas rnams: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs phyir gshegs su gsol: sgo skyong srung ma lha dang rig 'dzin dang: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: rgyal chen sde bzhi nor lha rgya mtshor bcas: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs phyir gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ hrī: de ltar 'phags pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas ni: mchod 'os bsgrub 'os 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: gnas 'dir byon la sgrub mchog 'khor bcas la: dbang gzhi bskur zhing byin gyis brlab pa dang: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sel ba dang: mchog thun dngos grub dam pa stsol ba dang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phrin las mdzod:

bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: rnam dag lhun grub gzhal yas 'dir: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan stengs su: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams: dgyes shing mi g.yo brtan par bzhugs: ma hā gu ru ār+ya lo ke shwa ra gha gha rā dza dz+nyā na dhā ki sa pa ri wā ra tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon rin po che: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la: gnyis su med par phyag 'tshal lo: ma hā gu ru a+r+yā lo ke shwa ra gha gha rā dza dz+nyā na dhā ki na mo pu ru sha ya ho: mchod pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs la: lha rdzas phyi yi mchod pa 'bul: rang byung nang gi mchod pa 'bul: gnyis med gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: ba liṃ gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'bul: rigs drug bsgral pa'i rak+ta 'bul: spang blang med pa'i mchod pa 'bul: mchod par 'os pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: bsten par 'os pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: bsgrub par 'os pa rnams kyi thugs dam bskang: ma hā gu ru ār+ya lo ke shwa ra gha gha rā dza dz+nyā na dhā ki sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ sman raka kha hi btags la mchod: bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: dri med pad sdong brtsegs pa'i mtsho gling du: skye med chos skus gzhan don sna tshogs mdzad: chos sku zhi zhal tshad med bzhi yi tshul: 'phags mchog thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal bstod: rnam dag gsung mchog pad+ma rigs kyi lha: sku mdog dmar po pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: thabs shes dbyer med pad rdor tshe bum bsnams: rigs mchog pad+ma'i rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod: phyag stong 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po stong: spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong: gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa: 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: rang byung gnyis med lhan cig skyes pa'i yum: bde stong zag med bde bas tshims mdzad ma:

dga' bzhi don gyi snang srid dbang sdud ma: gsang ye dhā ki ma la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'phags pa'i sras dang sras mo'i tshul 'dzin pa: nor 'dzin gsang 'dzin sgrol ma dkar sngon dang: rgyal ba rigs lnga sems dpa' lcam dral dang: thub drug sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: sangs rgyas stong rtsa tshad med sgo ba bzhi: bdag skyob lha dang rig 'dzin srung ma dang: rgyal chen sde bzhi nor lha rgya mtshor bcas: dregs pa lcam dral dam can rgya mtsho dang: bstod 'os kun kyang gus pas bstod par bgyi: tshogs mchod yang gsang bla sgrub ltar du bya'o: ghu ru dhe wa dhā ki nī sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: de nas bskul ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: ma g.yel ma g.yel bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs: ma g.yel ma g.yel kun bzang snang mtha' yas: ma g.yel ma g.yel 'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal: ma g.yel ma g.yel yab yum sras 'khor tshogs: ma g.yel ma g.yel dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma g.yel ma g.yel pho nya las mkhan tshogs: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku: spyan ras gzigs dbang yab yum sras 'khor bcas: po ta la yi gnas nas sku skyod la: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul ba dang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: rgyal ba'i spyi mes kun bzang snang mtha' yas: rang rig blo 'das lta ba'i gnas lugs la: ye grol rtogs pa'i thugs dam rgyud bskul gyis: nyon mongs las sgrib ma lus zhi ba dang: 'khor ba dong nas sprug pa'i phrin las mdzod: longs sku thub chen rgyal ba rigs lnga'i tshogs: rang rig rtog bral lta ba'i gshis lugs la: ma bcos ye grol thugs dam rgyud bskul gyis: rang rig ye shes rgyas par mdzad pa dang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: sprul sku sras mchog sems dpa' lcam dral te: rang rig rang grol spyod pa'i cho rol las: rang shar rang grol thugs dam rgyud bskul gyis: rang rig rang snang dbang sdud mdzad pa dang:

'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: pho nya las mkhan tshogs rnams sku skyod la: dregs pa lcam dral bka' sdod bran g.yog rnams: mthu stobs drag po'i klong nas sku skyod la: dgra bgegs mtha' yi dmag dpung zlog pa dang: thar pa'i gegs byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs: ngo bo nyid sku rta mchog dbang gi lha: rang rig 'khrul bral 'bras bu klong yangs la: sku bzhi rang chas thugs dam rgyud bskul gyis: rig grol dug lnga'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho sku skyod la: dgra bgegs mtha' yi dmag dpung zlog pa dang: thar pa'i gegs byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs: pho nya las mkhan tshogs rnams sku skyod cig: dregs pa lcam dral bka' sdod bran g.yog rnams: mthu stobs drag po'i klong nas sku skyod la: dgra bgegs mtha' yi dmag dpung zlog pa dang: thar pa'i gegs byed dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs: hūm̐ hrī: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gdug pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur ston pa: gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs sna tshogs ston: 'gag med gsung dbyangs nga ro phyogs bcur sgrogs: nyon mongs 'khor ba'i gcong nad rgyun chod la: log rtog gnyis snang mnyam nyid dbyings su spor: rang rig rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi'i 'gro don lhun grub cing: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: bka' gter bstan pa gnyan po bsrung mdzad pa: 'jig rten dang ni ye shes las grub pa'i: chos skyong zhing skyong lcam dral 'khor dang bcas: bka' sdod las mkhan pho nya bran g.yog rnams: thun khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe 'phags pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin: dam ldan rnal 'byor bdag gis rbad bskul gyis: mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul phyung ba'i dus la bab:

phrin las rnam bzhi'i las rnams gang bcol pa: skad cig thogs med myur du bsgrub tu gsol: sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan la 'tshe byed pa'i: zhing bcu'i dgra bgegs thams cad myur sgrol la: sdang dgra gnod byed za 'dre phung sri dang: god 'dre chung sri 'gab 'dre 'byung po rnams: skad cig myur sgrol thal ba rdul du rlogs: bka' gter bstan par 'tshe byed cing: dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad byed dang: rnal 'byor yongs la 'tshe byed pa'i: bar chad 'byung po thams cad rdul du rlogs: sa 'og sa steng sa blar rgyu ba yi: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus: 'byung bzhi'i lus la 'tshe byed pa'i: nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba dang: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: dngos grub len pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: rnam dag bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: 'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal po yab yum dang: sras 'khor dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas kyis: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sna tshogs kyi: dpag yas dngos grub sna tshogs bstsal du gsol: phrin las gang brtsam lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal: bum pa bzang dang dpag bsam nor bu'i tshul: yid bzhin re skong chen po'i dngos grub ni: da lta nyid du bdag la bstsal du gsol: yang dag bla med don dam bcud kyi gter: 'bad med dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i rin po che: gnas skabs mthu ldan 'bras bu phun tshogs shing: mchog thun dngos grub dam pa bstsal du gsol: lhag chad kha skong ba ni: 'phags pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag cag ma rig lus ngag yid gsum gyi: ma 'byor pa dang nyams chag ci mchis pa: gnong 'gyod drag po'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: bzod par bzhes nas tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bskang: ka dag klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzhag par bya'o: shis pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bskal bzang sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: 'gro kun thugs rjes skyob pa'i gnyen gcig po:

gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro blo'i mun sel ba: bla ma nam mkha'i rgyal po'i bkra shis shog: sna tshogs thabs sprul 'gro kun skyob mdzad cing: mchog thun dngos grub dam pa char 'beb pa: dhā ki sras 'khor sgo ba sgo ma'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog: phrin las gang brtsam thogs pa mi mnga' zhing: gang la gang 'dul sprul bsgyur sna tshogs 'gyed: ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung mdzad pa: mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis shog: dus dang gnas skabs ma lus thams cad du: sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen dar rgyas shing: skye 'gro yongs la bde skyid 'byung ba dang: bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: bsngo ba ni: na mo bdag cag dpon slob mched lcam 'khor bcas kyis: 'phags pa'i lha tshogs skyed rdzogs bsgrubs pa dang: zag bcas zag med dge ba ci bsags mthus: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'khor ba dong sprugs shog: bdag gzhan dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa: nam mkha'i mtha' khyab sems can ma lus pa: bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas: kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog:

ces rgyun spyod la gnas par bya'o: e ma 'phags mchog nam mkha'i rgyal po yi: sgrub thabs las byang nor bu pad phreng 'di: o rgyan ma hā gu ru'i bka' bzhin du: bud med mtsho rgyal bdag gis yi ger bkod: bka' 'di ma 'ongs snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog: bdud mgon seng gdong yab yum sras la gtad: thub par srungs shig badz+ra sa ma ya: sing hā mu kha si na ra ma dharma sa ma ya: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gnyan rgya: man+t+ra gu h+ya: dha thims: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor pa/ rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje yis/ sgro brag pad+ma 'od nas bton/ lo lnga'i bar du bka' rgyas gdams/ rig 'dzin chen po gar gyi dbang phyug chos rgya mtsho'i bka' yis bskul ba'i ngor/ rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje yis/ kaḥganam chos rgyal pho brang yang dben du/ shog ser ngos nas dag par phab pa yi/ yi ge'i rig byed o rgyan bstan srung ngo*/ ༈ /kye ma da lta bzhugs dang ma 'ongs 'byon rnams kun: yang dag don la rmongs pa'i sgrog gis bcings: rtog ge'i go yul shes rab phran bu yis: sgra don yin smra bka' gtsang ras chod mkhan: mkhas 'dod me khyer sprel 'dra'i gang zag 'gas: rang bzo ras chod rang tshugs babs col gyis: byin rlabs na bun yal dang bar chad rgyu: thar pa'i lam bgag grub thob skar tshogs bsgribs: mi khoms gnas ldan rtog ges bzo bcos na: bdud mgon yab yum bam ro pho mo yis: srog rtsa chod la snying khrag thang la phos: 'chi nas rdo rje dmyal bar skyol cig sa ma ya: k+ṣe tra pā las bka' 'di dam par chongs: tshul ldan rnams la mgon skyob grogs mdzod cig: sa ma ya: ྈྈྈྈྈ shog ser bu la zhal bshus pa'i yi ge pa ni/ dus mtha'i ban sbrang sa ta dharma pa ka ra'o// ji srid 'jig rten bskal pa ma stongs bar// de srid dam pa'i chos 'di ma rdzogs so// sarba dza ga staṃ//
